messages:
leo (sales): pinging the group — FinServe asked if we can show per-tenant token spend + request traces linked to traces in their APM. They want a single pane for chargeback and quick root-cause for cost spikes.

claire (solutions): adding details from the call: they want to slice by model, route, and embedding vs gen, and click through to the trace for a request id. Also need export to CSV for billing ops.

maya (pm): thanks. high-level questions: 1) is this a new dashboard + trace link, or reuse existing per-route dashboards? 2) SLA for delivery? 3) must this live in Private (VPC) or hosted is ok?

leo (sales): hosted is fine for the pilot. timeline: customer wants something demo-able in ~6 weeks, but will accept an MVP earlier.

zane (support): common ask. we have _some_ token attribution in telemetry but it's per-batch and not per-tenant cleanly. linking to traces currently relies on a generated trace_id in logs — not surfaced in console UI.

samir (eng): quick feasibility notes: - we already emit tenant_id and model_name in traces and metrics. - building a per-tenant cost rollup widget + drilldown is straightforward. - click-to-trace requires stitching request_id -> trace_id; we have that mapping in request logs but not indexed for fast lookup.

maya (pm): proposed MVP scope (for triage): 1) Console widget: per-tenant token spend (7d/30d/90d) + top routes. 2) Drilldown: list of requests for a given tenant/time range with columns: ts, route, model, tokens, request_id, trace_link. 3) Export CSV button. 4) Limited to hosted for initial release.

claire (solutions): acceptance criteria from customer: - can export last 30 days CSV - click trace opens APM with the right trace_id - can slice by model and route - < 2s table load for 1k rows

samir (eng): implementation notes: - need an index on request_id -> trace_id, we can add a small elasticsearch collection or a time-bucketed KV. - UI table and CSV export is ~2w work (frontend + product infra). - indexing + APIs ~2w. total ~4w eng effort + QA.

maya (pm): risks: cost of indexing extra fields (storage), PII considerations (ensure tenant scoping + RBAC), and perf for very large tenants. Mitigations: retention defaults 90d, opt-in for indexing beyond 90d, and role checks.

zane (support): note for security/compliance: if Private customers want this, we must support KMS-hardened exports and ensure CSVs don't leak tokens. Add checklist item.

oncall-bot: Reminder: schedule weekly sync created for #product on 1865435600 (automated).

maya (pm): next steps: - @samir can you confirm index approach (ES vs time-bucket KV) and rough infra cost? - @claire please get the exact CSV schema customer expects and examples. - @leo confirm pilot sign-off timeline. I'll add to roadmap candidate list and set priority P2 -> P1 if FinServe commits.

leo (sales): will push for a firm pilot dates by EOD tomorrow. customer is happy to sign pilot MOU if scope matches the MVP above. :thumbsup:

samir (eng): leaning KV time-bucketed index (cheaper at scale). I'll post a short design doc in #eng-runtime by EOD with rough cost numbers.

maya (pm): perfect — tagging this as "customer-visibility-pipeline" in the intake board. moving to backlog column: "needs scoping".

claire (solutions): good. I'll collect CSV examples and product examples from other customers to validate schema.

leo (sales): thanks team.
